items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Dickie Wells was sick and couldn't go so Jay filled in for him.

ctx.x: Dickie Wells was sick and couldn't go so Jay filled in for him. That's his name - Dickie Wells.
We played during intermission down here at the Festival. Benny Morton was on it. Just as I went to move I started to go down and he grabbed me and he grabbed my horn...
